From 8c964b82a4e97ec7f25e17b803ee196009b38a57 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Lin YuChen <starpt.official@gmail.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Mar 2026 01:25:02 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] staging: rtl8723bs: initialize le_tmp64 in rtw_BIP_verify()

Initialize le_tmp64 to zero in rtw_BIP_verify() to prevent using
uninitialized data.

Smatch warns that only 6 bytes are copied to this 8-byte (u64)
variable, leaving the last two bytes uninitialized:

drivers/staging/rtl8723bs/core/rtw_security.c:1308 rtw_BIP_verify()
warn: not copying enough bytes for '&le_tmp64' (8 vs 6 bytes)

Initializing the variable at the start of the function fixes this
warning and ensures predictable behavior.

Fixes: 554c0a3abf21 ("staging: Add rtl8723bs sdio wifi driver")
Cc: stable <stable@kernel.org>
Reported-by: Dan Carpenter <dan.carpenter@linaro.org>
Closes: https://lore.kernel.org/linux-staging/abvwIQh0CHTp4wNJ@stanley.mountain/
Signed-off-by: Lin YuChen <starpt.official@gmail.com>
Reviewed-by: Dan Carpenter <dan.carpenter@linaro.org>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260320172502.167332-1-starpt.official@gmail.com
Signed-off-by: Greg Kroah-Hartman <gregkh@linuxfoundation.org>

diff --git a/drivers/staging/rtl8723bs/core/rtw_security.c b/drivers/staging/rtl8723bs/core/rtw_security.c
index 64c05437ff01..8f1f960b7535 100644
--- a/drivers/staging/rtl8723bs/core/rtw_security.c
+++ b/drivers/staging/rtl8723bs/core/rtw_security.c
@@ -1285,7 +1285,7 @@ u32 rtw_BIP_verify(struct adapter *padapter, u8 *precvframe)
 	u8 mic[16];
 	struct mlme_ext_priv *pmlmeext = &padapter->mlmeextpriv;
 	__le16 le_tmp;
-	__le64 le_tmp64;
+	__le64 le_tmp64 = 0;
 
 	ori_len = pattrib->pkt_len - WLAN_HDR_A3_LEN + BIP_AAD_SIZE;
 	BIP_AAD = kzalloc(ori_len, GFP_KERNEL);
-- 
2.34.1

The patch modifies a single file to fix an uninitialized variable issue in the `rtw_BIP_verify()` function. The change is a straightforward initialization that prevents undefined behavior and resolves a static analysis warning.

### Modifications in each file:
- **drivers/staging/rtl8723bs/core/rtw_security.c**:  
  Changed the declaration of `__le64 le_tmp64` to `__le64 le_tmp64 = 0;`. This initializes the 8-byte variable to zero, ensuring the last two bytes, which were previously not copied from a 6-byte source, have a defined value.

### Relationship between modifications:
- The single initialization directly addresses the Smatch warning (`warn: not copying enough bytes for '&le_tmp64' (8 vs 6 bytes)`) by guaranteeing that all 8 bytes of `le_tmp64` are initialized. This prevents the use of uninitialized stack data, which could cause unpredictable behavior or security issues. The fix is minimal and targeted, affecting only the variable's initial state without altering any other logic.
